interventions.action: Deleted src/app/setup-check.tsx, the preview client component init wrote, after rewriting src/app/page.tsx to render the Pantry screen.

interventions.step: Exercise the production build in a browser
interventions.action: Installed playwright-core in a scratch directory (work/.scratch/browser, outside ./larder) and drove the installed Google Chrome against `npm run start`. It checked phone and laptop widths, dark, light and system mode, explicit data-theme, reduced motion, selecting items, keyboard Select open/Escape/focus return, empty and valid submissions, and horizontal overflow.
interventions.reason: The guidance asks for production checks in both modes and both widths, and init's report says no browser check ran. No guidance names a browser tool.

decisions.choice: Accepted the documented font fallback instead of loading Figtree and IBM Plex Mono
options: Load the faces the theme names (for example with next/font or self-hosted files)
decisions.why: The export carries font stacks but loads no files, and the guidance allows either option. Loading from Google Fonts would mean an outside network host. next/font also renames the family, so it would not match the 'Figtree' name in the token stack without overriding the token. The screen renders in the system UI fallback.

decisions.choice: Left <html> without data-theme, so the screen follows the system color scheme (dark when no preference), with no mode switch
decisions.why: The brief needs both modes to work, and system mode gives both without pinning one. The guidance says not to add a separate mode switch for the theme artifact. Explicit data-theme values were verified to work too.

decisions.choice: Ran init's optional agent-setup step: `git init` in ./larder, then `ultima install --harness claude`
options: git init and install the skill and hooks for a harness
decisions.why: The brief counts the installed skill as allowed guidance, and init printed these exact commands. This adds .git, .claude/skills/ultima-design/SKILL.md and .claude/settings.json to the project.

decisions.choice: Chose the category with a portalled Select rather than opening the form in a Dialog
decisions.why: At the intake desk, an always-visible form is faster than opening a dialog. The root CSS theme reaches body portals, so the popup needs no container. It opens with Enter or ArrowDown, closes on Escape and returns focus to the trigger.

decisions.choice: Category badges use Badge's default neutral tone. Low stock uses tone="warning". No badge uses the accent tone.
decisions.why: The brief keeps the brand accent out of status meaning, and a category is neither brand nor status. Low stock is a status, so it gets warning. The brand accent shows on the primary Button, focus rings and the Larder wordmark (accent-text).

decisions.choice: Quantity uses the Ultima Input with type="number", inputMode="numeric", min 1 and step 1, and the app checks for a whole number
decisions.why: The catalogue has no number field. Input keeps Field's label, error and invalid styling, and a numeric keyboard shows on phones.
